Conjecture
[Quasi-Fuchsian realization conjecture] 1. Conjecture 8.10.10\group lamination realizationSource: thurston:page-0230 For any cusp-preserving map $f:S\to N$, the image subgroup is quasi-Fuchsian if and only if every geodesic lamination of $S$ is realizable in the homotopy class of $f$.
